segments.name: BancFirst metropolitan banks
segments.description: Provides full-range commercial banking services to retail customers and businesses in Oklahoma metropolitan areas.
segments.evidence: The Company has six principal business units: BancFirst metropolitan banks, BancFirst community banks, Pegasus, Worthington, other financial services and executive operations and support.

segments.name: BancFirst community banks
products: commercial, real estate, energy, agricultural and consumer lending
segments.description: Community banking offices serving retail customers and small to medium-sized businesses in non-metropolitan Oklahoma trade centers.
segments.evidence: BancFirst's strategy focuses on providing a full range of commercial banking services to retail customers and small to medium-sized businesses in both the non-metropolitan trade centers and cities in the metropolitan statistical areas of Oklahoma.

segments.name: Pegasus
segments.description: Texas state-chartered bank providing banking services to individual and corporate customers in the Dallas Metroplex.
segments.evidence: Pegasus and Worthington's lending activities include private banking, commercial and residential real estate, commercial and industrial and energy loans.

segments.name: Worthington
segments.description: Texas state-chartered bank providing banking services to individual and corporate customers in the Fort Worth Metroplex.
segments.evidence: Pegasus and Worthington's lending activities include private banking, commercial and residential real estate, commercial and industrial and energy loans.

segments.name: Other financial services
segments.description: Provides insurance agency services, trust and investment management, and other financial services to individuals, corporations and governmental units.
segments.evidence: Insurance services offered through BancFirst Insurance Services, Inc. consists of business and personal insurance, employee benefits, surety bonds and claims and risk management.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest on loans and investments, and collects fees and service charges on deposits and other banking, trust and insurance services from individual and corporate customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The major areas of competition include interest rates charged on loans, underwriting terms and conditions, interest rates paid on deposits, fees on non-credit services, levels of service charges on deposits, completeness of product lines and quality of service.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired American Bank of Oklahoma, which merged with BancFirst in February 2026.
changes.evidence: As reported by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC"), the Company's (including ABOK acquired November 17, 2025) market share of deposits within the state of Oklahoma was 7.58% as of June 30, 2025 and 6.84% as of June 30, 2024.
